name: Can I dry out water damage myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I dry out water damage myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: For minor water spills that are quickly contained, you might be able to dry the area yourself using towels and fans. However, for significant water intrusion, hidden moisture, or prolonged exposure, professional services are highly recommended. Professionals use specialized equipment to detect hidden moisture, thoroughly dry materials, and prevent mold growth, which often isn't possible with standard household items. Improper DIY drying can lead to costly secondary damage later on.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor spills can be dried with towels and fans, but significant or prolonged water damage requires professionals to prevent hidden moisture and mold.
